newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Warehouse says November trading erratic.
newsitem.headline: Warehouse says November trading erratic.

text.p: The Warehouse Group Ltd Managing Director Stephen Tindall told the annual meeting on Wednesday that while the short and medium term outlook for the company was encouraging, November trading had been indifferent and erratic.

"Since the close of the trading period under review we have released our quarterly sales figures. Our sales in the first three months of the current year, whilst indifferent and erratic, were 17.5 percent higher than last year.
"Since then, November trading has also been indifferent and erratic, but we are now moving to the critical Christmas and summer trading period."
Tindall said the future offered no shortage of challenges.
